title: Tra Que Vegetable Village Cooking Class
description: Step outside Hoi An into the tranquil Tra Que Vegetable Village, where you will harvest hyper-local herbs before a hands-on Central Vietnamese cooking.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * The Tra Que Vegetable Village, a 300-year-old organic agricultural village near Hoi An, offers a 4-hour morning cooking class focused on Central Vietnamese cuisine. Participants harvest herbs like sweet basil and mint, then prepare dishes such as Tam Huu and Banh Xeo.
> * This experience involves moderate physical demand, including cycling and light farming, and is available year-round with advance booking required. AGS provides luxury SUV transfers and priority reservations.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Step outside Hoi An into the tranquil Tra Que Vegetable Village, where you will harvest hyper-local herbs before a hands-on Central Vietnamese cooking masterclass.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Tra Que is a 300-year-old organic agricultural village supplying Hoi An with its distinct, potent herbs. The cooking schools here bridge the gap between ancient organic farming utilizing river algae and the high-end culinary traditions of the coast.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Cycle from your Hoi An resort to the village. You will don traditional farming gear and join local farmers in planting, watering, and harvesting herbs like sweet basil and mint. 

After freshening up, a local chef will guide you in preparing regional specialties—such as Tam Huu (shrimp and pork rolls) and Banh Xeo (sizzling pancakes) using the exact ingredients you just pulled from the soil. You enjoy your creations overlooking the peaceful fields.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Rustic, Educational, Farm-to-Table |
| **Duration** | 4 Hours (Morning) |
| **Physical Demand** | Moderate (Cycling and light farming) |
| **Best Paired With** | A slow morning in Hoi An before relaxing at the beach. |

## A Tranquil Farm-to-Table Morning Between An Bang Beach & Hoi An Ancient Town
Located directly between the UNESCO lanes of Hoi An Ancient Town and our private beachfront villa enclave at An Bang—less than 5 minutes from [An Bang Holiday Villa](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/), [An Bang Salt Villa](/accommodations/vietnam/an-bang-beach-villas/), and [Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai](/accommodations/vietnam/four-seasons-nam-hai/)—**Tra Que Vegetable Village** is a 40-hectare organic garden island surrounded by the De Vong River and Tra Que lagoon. For over three centuries, village farmers have enriched this sandy alluvial soil exclusively with mineral-rich river seaweed (*rong sông*) harvested by bamboo boat each dawn, refusing chemical fertilizers to grow Vietnam’s most aromatic miniature basil, sawtooth coriander, Vietnamese mint (*rau răm*), and perilla.

Because Tra Que sits right along the coastal corridor linking [Montgomerie Links](/courses/vietnam/montgomerie-links/) and [BRG Da Nang Golf Resort](/courses/vietnam/brg-da-nang-norman/) (15 minutes north) with [Hoiana Shores Golf Club](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/) (20 minutes south), it is the easiest half-day culinary immersion to slot into [Hoi An Beachfront Bliss](/tours/hoi-an-beachfront-bliss/).

## Herb Harvesting, Foot Soak & Open-Air Garden Kitchen
* **Optional E-Bike or Luxury SUV Arrival:** Guests staying at our An Bang villas or [Almanity Hoi An Resort & Spa](/accommodations/vietnam/almanity-hoi-an/) can either pedal 10 minutes along quiet rice-paddy paths with a private guide or arrive directly at the garden gate by air-conditioned SUV.
* **Hands-On Seaweed Mulching & Herbal Foot Ritual:** Walk the raised herb beds with a third-generation Tra Que family, try raking river-algae compost with bamboo yokes, and sit down to a 20-minute warm herbal foot soak infused with crushed lemongrass, ginger, and kaffir lime leaves—ideal for tired calves after walking 18 holes at [Hoiana Shores](/courses/vietnam/hoiana-shores/).
* **Garden Pavilion Cooking Session:** Harvest your own greens and step into the shaded garden kitchen to prepare Tra Que’s signature *Tam Hữu* (three-friend herb wraps of tiger prawn, pork belly, and spring onion tied with blanched chive stems) and crispy *Bánh Xèo* pancakes.

faqs.q: Where is Tra Que Vegetable Village located in relation to An Bang Beach and Hoi An?
faqs.a: Tra Que sits just 5 minutes inland from An Bang Beachfront Villas and Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai, and 10 minutes north of Hoi An Ancient Town—right between BRG Da Nang Golf Resort (15 minutes north) and Hoiana Shores Golf Club (20 minutes south).

faqs.q: Do we have to cycle or do heavy farm work during the Tra Que Village Cooking Class?
faqs.a: No. Both the bicycle ride and the garden raking demonstration are completely optional; Asia Golf Specialists provides door-to-door luxury SUV transfers and focuses the morning on herb tasting, a soothing lemongrass foot massage, and hands-on cooking.

faqs.q: What makes the herbs grown in Tra Que Village unique in Central Vietnam?
faqs.a: Tra Que farmers fertilize their sandy lagoon soil strictly with organic seaweed harvested from the De Vong River rather than chemical fertilizers, producing smaller, intensely fragrant mint, basil, and coriander leaves prized by Hoi An's top chefs.
